releaseNotes:
• Official Brand Logo & App Icon: High-res PulseForge AI athlete silhouette, metallic P glyph, glowing pulse, and dumbbell insignia integrated across the app icon, dashboard header, onboarding, and theme settings.
• 100% Real Phone Hardware Sensor Telemetry Engine (9 Streams): Step Count, Step Cadence (SPM), Automatic Activity Detection (Still/Walk/Run/Cycle/Vehicle), Distance Traveled, Speed & Pace, GPS Routes, Elevation Gain & Floors Climbed (Barometer), MET Active Calories Burned, and Screen-off Sleep Estimates.
• Strict Real-Data-Only Rule: All unrecorded or zero telemetry values displayed strictly as '-' across all cards and graphs with zero synthetic/duplicate values.
• Real Data Graph Rendering: MultiWaveformActivityGraphCard, LavenderGraphicUpdateCard, SplitMetricsCards, BiometricTriMetricsCard, and ArchVaultTrioCard only render 100% authentic measured data with flatline resting baselines when idle.
